root_family.canonical_name: Freight Logistics, Cargo Moving & Transportation Services
root_family.definition: Cross-country dry cargo trucking services, residential furniture house-moving, refrigerated food transport, and customs freight forwarding.

translations.am: የጭነት ትራንስፖርት፣ የቤት እቃ ማጓጓዝ እና ሎጂስቲክስ

children.definition: Professional loading, padded packing, transport, and unloading for household furniture and corporate offices.
